description: This file contains the implementation of the PSR-7 HTTP request object in the GuzzleHttp library, including methods for constructing and modifying HTTP requests within the library's framework.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Implements a PSR-7 HTTP request, supporting HTTP method, URI, headers, request target, and protocol version modifications.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new HTTP request with method, URI, headers, body, and protocol version.

methods.name: getRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns the request target, defaulting to the URI path and query.

methods.name: withRequestTarget
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified request target, validating for whitespace.

methods.name: getMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method of the request.

methods.name: withMethod
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified HTTP method.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI object associated with the request.

methods.name: withUri
methods.description: Returns a new instance with the specified URI, optionally preserving the host header.

methods.name: updateHostFromUri
methods.description: Updates the Host header based on the URI's host and port.

methods.name: assertMethod
methods.description: Validates that the provided method is a non-empty string.
